title: 评估推理模型对预设前提查询的处理能力
summary: 该研究构建了包含不同程度预设前提（涉及健康、科学和常识）的查询，评估大型推理模型（LRM）是否能够推理并恰当回应用户查询中的错误假设。与普通模型相比，推理模型准确率略高（2-11%），但仍无法挑战26-42%的虚假预设，且易受预设表达强度影响。
summary_en: This study constructs queries with varying degrees of presuppositions across health, science, and general knowledge to evaluate whether large reasoning models (LRMs) can reason about underlying assumptions and respond appropriately. Compared to non-reasoning models, reasoning models achieve slightly higher accuracy (2-11%) but still fail to challenge 26-42% of false presuppositions and remain susceptible to presupposition strength.
